frame_convention: T3 60fps -> seconds; damage scaled T3 170HP -> WH 100HP

union_merge.method: additive union of all historical versions of this file (548 versions / 60 commits / all refs) over current main; identity = canonical input (entry.input, else key); main preserved verbatim, main wins contested inputs (PR #357 precedent)
union_merge.era_note: final set era census: T8/WH-newest=10, T3=14; additions selected newest-era first (T8/T7/TTT2/T6+other teardowns), T3 payloads used only where no newer expression exists; union-first, no-loss absolute

cornerstone_build.method: additive union of game/assets/movesets/ryuji.json (full KOF Yamazaki set, 103 moves) into this file; identity = canonical input; pre-existing entries win contested inputs and are preserved verbatim (deep-equal verified against origin/main)

stance.name: Yamazaki stance
stance.canon: Ryuji Yamazaki's stance — the Hakkesshu slouch: hands loose, head tilted, tongue flicking out (Sadomazo).
